_source: Built from the facts of CBP ruling N352223 (2025-08-22, dev split; picked: no China-held ruling; earliest dev): CBP held Philippines. Product drafted by gemini-4-argon from the facts, reviewed by hand. Target Japan (reverse probe: away from a non-China origin); plant capabilities for Japan are an assumption. No later ruling on a changed setup, so there is no backtest.

product.name: LumiFree
product.description: A liquid crystal (LC) device installed within an LED light source to alter the shape and distribution of light when connected to a smart device via a control board. It consists of multiple layered liquid crystal panels on a glass substrate with attached flexible printed circuits (FPC) and a separate driving board.

components.name: Liquid crystal panel on glass substrate

operations.name: Create liquid crystal panel by depositing a thin film of crystals onto a glass substrate
Create driving board via surface mount technology (SMT)
Cut liquid crystal panel to the necessary size
Attach flexible printed circuits (FPC) to panels
Perform optical bonding process on modules
Tape modules together in the correct configuration
Package driving board and LumiFree module together for shipment
